question: What Are Process Variables?
body_html:
Process variables are the physical quantities that an instrumentation and control system measures, monitors and controls; the five primary ones are flow, pressure, temperature, level and quality.

VariableUnitsTypical Instruments
Flowm³/h, kg/hOrifice, vortex, Coriolis, magnetic
PressurekPa, bar, psiBourdon gauge, diaphragm transmitter
Temperature°C, KRTD, thermocouple
Levelm, %Level transmitter
QualitypH, ppmAnalyser transmitter

Each is usually sent to the DCS or PLC as a 4 to 20 mA signal.
